remaining_limitations: Source-to-target transport and quantitative allocation of discrepancy causes are unverified.
Within-cell covariance, old sex-specific moments, dependence interpolation and model family/tails remain assumption-dependent.
Applying marginal source SDs to conditional distributions may overstate dispersion.
Ages 55-64 have no direct admitted US anchor; menopause, kidney function, medication and other latent variables are unmodeled.
Coefficient uncertainty and model/transport uncertainty are not probabilistically represented; seeds only vary fictional individuals.
Mean/SD agreement is not target validation, causal evidence, clinical validity or publication readiness.
